parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: The traffic direction for the Internet Border.

parameters.name: ListType
parameters.description: The type of address in the Internet Border whitelist.

parameters.name: ListValue
parameters.description:
The value of the Internet Border whitelist.

- If ListType is set to `Custom`: the name of the address book.

- If ListType is set to `Address book`: the IPv4 address.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the visitor.

parameters.name: WhiteType
parameters.description: The type of source or destination for which the Internet Border whitelist takes effect.
